card.name: Digits inside numbers in data tables
card.fires_on: A single digit token in the middle of a multi-digit number, often the second or third digit. It shows up in trial tables, such as counts in parentheses like (28/2<<0>>3), and in lab values or conversion factors.

modes.label: Patient counts in fractions
modes.description: A digit inside the numerator or denominator of an n/N count after a percentage.

modes.label: Digits in values and conversions
modes.description: A digit within a decimal or multi-digit value such as a conversion factor or concentration.
